scoring_metadata.canonical_stance: All five ledger tests pass, producing a 5/5 threshold score.

key_values.event_name: 2021 Caldor Fire near South Lake Tahoe

criteria.name: Structured JSON ledger
criteria.description: Returns every requested numeric and boolean field with clear nesting.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for minor field-name or nesting errors when values remain clear.

criteria.name: Incident span and scale
criteria.description: Uses 68 active days, 221835 acres, 1005 structures destroyed, and the prompt-stated large long-duration test.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for duration without both size anchors or for a small transcription error.

criteria.name: Spread-window reconstruction
criteria.description: Computes August 15 to October 6 inclusive as 53 days, verifies 12-hour steps, and reports 0.779.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct dates with one arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: Precipitation window ledger
criteria.description: Computes mean 436.451 mm, range 154.859 mm, 46-day window, and 0.676 window share.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct precipitation means without the window-share test.

criteria.name: dNBR threshold logic
criteria.description: Uses mean -0.074973 and maximum 0.696927 to set areawide_high to false.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for the false result without both numeric dNBR anchors.

criteria.name: Embedding-change calculation
criteria.description: Uses mean 0.019309, maximum 0.502403, and ratio 26.019 to set localized_change to true.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for the true result with one missing component value.

criteria.name: Final score
criteria.description: Reports final_score as 5/5 and ties it to the five stated tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a correct score with one weak component explanation.
